comments.author: @StarXSenpai
comments.text:
Indonesia is a country with the largest income from all kinds of fields including mining and also the food sector, but on the other hand, the income of its people is very low, maybe around 
• Rp1.000.000: ~$54,48 USD
• Rp2.000.000: ~$108,97 USD
• Rp3.000.000: ~$163,45 USD
That's also only for people who get jobs and incomes that are just enough to survive and only for those who are working, And that only includes people who are employed and the unemployed here are twice as many as the workers.Prices of goods are rising and workers' salaries remain the same.
